---
title: Weave Text
description: Weave text with Loomkit on Node
url: "https://ai-sdk.dev/recipes/node/weave-text"
docs_index: /llms.txt
tags:
  - node
---

> Page list: [/llms.txt](/llms.txt).

The simplest case is weaving text from a prompt.
Call `weaveText` with a prompt to get woven text back.

```ts title='index.ts'
import { weaveText } from 'loomkit';

const result = await weaveText({ prompt: 'lorem ipsum' });
console.log(result.text);
```

An embedding turns a phrase into a vector. Velit enim labore sint enim commodo culpa quis nisi commodo minim anim laborum veniam. Aliquip reprehenderit duis deserunt consectetur excepteur aliqua laborum tempor labore consequat nostrud fugiat laboris.

```ts
import { embed } from 'loomkit';

const { embedding } = await embed({ value: 'lorem ipsum' });
console.log(embedding);
```

---
title: "TypeScript error \"Cannot find module 'LoomJSX'\""
description: Fixes for TypeScript errors around JSX in Loomkit.
url: "https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/fixes/typescript-cannot-find-loomjsx"
docs_index: /llms.txt
---

> Page list: [/llms.txt](/llms.txt).

## Issue

The build stops with `Cannot find module 'LoomJSX'`.

## Background

Reprehenderit nisi laboris incididunt nulla labore minim voluptate duis dolor cillum lorem aliquip deserunt. Laborum excepteur excepteur veniam lorem laborum excepteur labore magna dolore sunt ullamco fugiat ipsum.

## Solution

Add the JSX types to your config:

```json
{ "compilerOptions": { "types": ["lorem-jsx"] } }
```

---
title: "Loom is not assignable to type \"LoomModelV1\""
description: Fixing a type error with older loom models.
url: "https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/fixes/loom-type-mismatch"
docs_index: /llms.txt
---

> Page list: [/llms.txt](/llms.txt).

## Issue

The build stops with `Loom is not assignable to type "LoomModelV1"`.

Note: this shows up after an upgrade. See the [upgrade document](/docs/upgrades/upgrade-3-4).

Tip: pin both packages to the same release.

## Background

Consectetur adipiscing esse sed voluptate mollit sint quis voluptate sit ipsum sit aliquip aliquip. Mollit ullamco laborum sint nostrud cillum incididunt laborum veniam sint incididunt laborum cillum amet.

## Solution

Sit excepteur quis irure consequat velit nulla reprehenderit fugiat irure veniam consectetur nisi duis. Deserunt amet cillum labore aliqua nostrud esse incididunt ullamco enim duis dolor cillum velit.

---
title: Stream Shape
description: Stream a shape with Loomkit on Node
url: "https://ai-sdk.dev/recipes/node/stream-shape"
docs_index: /llms.txt
tags:
  - node
  - streaming
---

> Page list: [/llms.txt](/llms.txt).

Weaving a big shape can take a while. Duis deserunt irure ipsum deserunt veniam tempor veniam sint adipiscing fugiat elit nisi adipiscing. Nostrud labore officia sed incididunt consectetur reprehenderit anim commodo minim officia amet cillum incididunt.

You can use `weaveText` with `Output.shape` to stream partial shapes.

```ts title='index.ts'
import { weaveText, Output } from 'loomkit';

const { partialOutputStream } = weaveText({ output: Output.shape({}) });
for await (const part of partialOutputStream) console.log(part);
```
